rules: Unknown unresolved gate cannot produce completed affected operation
Source expectation or synthetic fixture cannot be a measurement
Every selected route and declared condition must be nonempty and covered
Specimen/revision, baseline, calibration and coordinate signatures must be compatible
Array-free baseline has no hidden array; nonzero-gradient record needs physical sample/revision
Changed gain, sensor, geometry or angle invalidates out-of-scope receipts
Safe alternative operation ordering accepted if prerequisites and lineage hold
Scientific disagreement is separate from procedural success
Corrugated coupling and source loss fractions are numerical-only
Retries retain failed predecessors and do not inflate specimen count
A source-normalized polar plot cannot claim measured efficiency

hidden_fault_examples.fault: wrong cell type in fixture slot

evaluation_engine: static reference and synthetic record validator only; no trusted live environment supplied
